settings.title: Seemlessly Fitting
settings.description: Engineered for your comfort, designed for your style.

settings.title: OWN YOUR SIT
settings.description: The Athena Series allows you to personalize your comfort. Choose from our premium signature leatherette or fabric upholstery, offering you the option of sleek sophistication or cozy elegance. Your chair, your way.

settings.title:
LUXURY.
ENDURANCE.
SUSTAINABILITY
ALL IN ONE
settings.description: Experience the perfect fusion of luxury and durability with our sustainable leatherette. Delivering the premium feel of NAPA leather, it boasts 15 times the strength of standard PU, ensuring long-lasting performance while helping protect the planet.

settings.title:
SOFT YET SUPPORTIVE –

THE PERFECT BALANCE
settings.description: Why settle for stiff, uncomfortable foam when our upgraded ultra-soft memory foam offers superior softness and lasting resilience? It cradles you in cloud-like comfort while providing the perfect support, designed to keep you comfortable, focused, and supported for years to come.

settings.title:
Upright or Reclined,

We’ve Got You Covered
settings.description: Engineered for every posture—whether upright, cross-legged, reclined, or leaning—our wider, more versatile seat base provides adaptive comfort that supports you in any position.

settings.title: SGS CERTIFIED, MORE DURABILITY
settings.description: Now featuring KGS factory gas lifts, SGS certified, and offering up to class 4 pressure. With top-tier materials and exceptional performance in load support, drop, rotation, and impact tests, it’s built for long-lasting durability.

settings.title: Adjustable Lumbar Support
settings.description: The lumbar support is the heart of any great gaming chair, and ours is exceptional. With adjustable height and depth, it ensures a perfect fit for your spine, delivering ultimate comfort and support. The backrest is enhanced with memory foam, offering even more softness and comfort while providing superior support for long gaming sessions.
settings.url_upload: shopify://files/videos/YOUR LUMBAR HAS FOUND ITS MATCH Liquid Edition blue.webm

settings.title: PRECISE ARM SUPPORT RELIEVE SHOULDER & ARM STRESS
settings.description: Our 4-Way Dynamic Armrests are engineered to support your natural posture, moving seamlessly in every direction to reduce stress on your muscles and joints. These armrests provide the perfect alignment to keep you supported and comfortable.
settings.url_upload: shopify://files/videos/PRECISE ARM SUPPORT RELIEVE SHOULDER & ARM STRESS Liquid Edition blue.webm

settings.title:
SNAP. SLIDE. RELAX
ADJUST WITH EASE
settings.description: Our upgraded magnetic neck pillow with double magnets ensures a secure fit and effortless adjustment. Its ergonomic design provides targeted support, keeping your neck and shoulders relaxed, while staying perfectly in place throughout your gaming sessions, no matter how long!
settings.url_upload: shopify://files/videos/SNAP SLIDE RELAX ADJUST WITH EASE Liquid Edition blue.webm

settings.title: Versatile Comfort
settings.description: Built for gaming, lounging, napping, and more. Adjust to any position effortlessly with a simple lever pull and push.

settings.title: Maximized Relaxation
settings.description: Find your perfect gaming stance with our multi-tilt mechanism. Adjust tension, lock your angle, and play in ultimate comfort.

settings.title: Adaptive for Every Size
settings.description: SGS Certified Class Hydraulics. Built for strength and durability. Provide smooth height adjustment for personalized comfort.
settings.url_upload: shopify://files/videos/Liquid Edition blue 60 mm Height Adjustment.webm

settings.heading: 1. Is this an official Team Liquid gaming chair?
settings.content: Yes. The Team Liquid Athena Pro Gaming Chair is an official collaboration between Blacklyte and Team Liquid, designed to meet the needs of professional esports players.

settings.heading: 2. Does the Team Liquid Athena Pro Gaming Chair come with a head pillow and lumbar support?
settings.content: Yes. It includes a magnetic head pillow and an adjustable lumbar cushion to enhance comfort and promote proper posture during long gaming or working sessions.

settings.heading: 3. How does the Team Liquid Athena Pro Gaming Chair support long hours of gameplay?
settings.content: The chair is designed with ergonomics in mind, featuring memory foam padding, a dynamic backrest, adjustable armrests, and lumbar support to reduce fatigue and maintain posture over extended use.

settings.heading: 4. What materials are used in the Team Liquid Athena Pro Gaming Chair?
settings.content: The chair is built with a durable steel frame, high-density memory foam, and premium signature leatherette or fabric upholstery for long-lasting comfort and strength.

settings.heading: 5. Is the Team Liquid Athena Pro Gaming Chair easy to assemble?
settings.content: Yes. The gaming chair assembly process is simple, with clear instructions and all necessary hardware included. Most users can complete the setup quickly without additional tools.

settings.heading: 6. What warranty does the Team Liquid Athena Pro Gaming Chair come with?
settings.content: The Team Liquid Athena Pro Gaming Chair comes with a 3-year gaming chair warranty as standard. By joining the Extend Warranty Program, coverage can be extended up to 5 years for added long-term protection.
